title: Technical Expert, Environmental Monitoring and Contamination Control for Aseptic Process, Sterility Assurance, Osaka Site Quality / 大阪工場  無菌性保証グループ 無菌プロセスのEMおよび汚染管理の専門技術者（課長代理）
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use.  I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

Job Description

Please note this job requires business level Japanese in speaking, writing, and reading.

タケダの紹介

タケダでは常に患者さんを中心に考え、世界中の人々により健やかで輝かしい未来をお届けすることを目指してきました。そして従業員一人ひとりにそれぞれの能力と熱意に応じた成長の機会を提供することにも組んで取り組んでいます。私たちと一緒に、世界中の人々のいのちに貢献し、さらなる成長と活躍を目指しませんか。

タケダは国内第一の製薬企業、そして業界を牽引するグローバルリーダーです。従業員は四つの優先順位（患者さん中心、社会との信頼関係構築、レピュテーションの向上、事業の発展）とタケダイズム（誠実＝公正・正直・不屈）のもと一致団結しています。タケダイズムは私たちの信念であり正しい方向へ導く羅針盤です。私たちは日々の業務においてタケダイズムを体現しています。

募集部門の紹介

無菌性保証グループは「優れた医薬品を患者さんに届けるため高い品質を管理する」ことを組織の責務としています。世界中の患者さんに医薬品を届けるため、無菌医薬品の製造エリアの環境管理や汚染管理、製剤・原薬・原材料の微生物試験による品質管理、分析機器の管理など品質管理に関する業務を幅広く担っています。

募集職種

Technical Expert, Environmental Monitoring and Contamination Control for Aseptic Process  /無菌プロセスのEMおよび汚染管理の専門技術者

職務内容

無菌医薬品の無菌性保証のため、以下の職務に従事いただきます。

無菌プロセスのEMおよび汚染管理の専門技術者

・製造エリアのEM管理、トレンド分析、文書管理

・Site CCSの維持管理、CCS文書管理、アセスメント作成

・EMおよび関連機器のクオリフィケーション

・Global文書とのGAP評価、和訳

応募必須条件

＜実務経験＞　

メーカー等にて、社内人として概ね5年以上の品質管理業務（環境モニタリング、微生物試験）の実務経験を有すること

＜学歴＞

学卒・院卒：理系の学位を取得していること（ライフサイエンス・バイオ系の分野を専攻している方は歓迎）

＜語学力＞

英文資料を読解・作成できるレベル（目安：TOEIC 700点）

望ましい実務経験・スキル等

・医薬品メーカーでの就業経験

・統計解析業務経験

・CCS構築、運用管理経験

・英語での会議、Global部門とのコミュニケーション

勤務形態

・ フレックスタイム勤務

・ 土日祝　週休２日

title: TBS Finance Solutions Delivery Lead, Takeda Business Solutions, Japan
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use.  I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

Job Description

Please note that this job requires business-level Japanese speaking, writing, and reading skills.

タケダの紹介

タケダは「世界中の人々の健康と輝かしい未来に貢献する」ことを企業の存在意義（パーパス）としています。そして目指す未来を共有しながら、一人ひとりが自分の可能性を引き出し、お互いの個性を認め合う、多様性にあふれた先進的な組織作りに取り組んでいます。私たちと一緒に、世界中の人々のいのちに貢献し、さらなる成長と活躍を目指しませんか。

タケダはグローバルな研究開発型のバイオ医薬品のリーディングカンパニーです。従業員は創業時から受け継いできたタケダの価値観であるタケダイズム（誠実＝公正・正直・不屈）を道しるべとしながら、患者さんに寄り添い（Patient）人々と信頼関係を築き（Trust）社会的評価を向上させ（Reputation）持続可能な事業を発展させる（Business）を日々の行動指針としています。

”Better Health for People, Brighter Future for the World” is the purpose of a company. We aim to create a diverse and inclusive organization where people can thrive, grow and realize their own potential while enabling our purpose. We continue to innovate and drive changes that will transform the lives of patients. We’re looking for like-minded professionals to join us.

Takeda is a global values-based, R&D-driven biopharmaceutical leader. We are guided by our values of Takeda-ism, which has been passed down since the company’s founding. Takeda-ism incorporates Integrity, Fairness, Honesty, and Perseverance, with Integrity at the core. They are brought to life through actions based on Patient-Trust-Reputation-Business, in this order.

OBJECTIVES / PURPOSE

As part of Takeda’s Global Capability Model, we are advancing globally scaled ways of working to drive efficiency, standardization, and broader access to capabilities.

Takeda Business Solutions (TBS) is a global organization that partners with the business and uses data and digital capabilities to standardize and optimize end-to-end Finance and Procurement processes. With a clear line of sight to the patient, TBS creates seamless experiences that free up our people to focus on our purpose: better health for people and a brighter future for the world.

Within TBS, the Finance Solutions tower is responsible for global accounting operations, including record-to-report, invoice-to-cash, acquire-to-retire, treasury solutions, tax solutions, statutory financial reporting, and Record-to-Disclose global process ownership.

The Japan Delivery Center Lead is part of the TBS Finance Solutions tower and is accountable for Japan finance operations, delivering lean, harmonized, and high-quality processes, driving alignment to global standards, and providing strong in-country business leadership. The role combines operations leadership, transformation delivery, and strategic business partnering to position Finance Solutions Japan within a global, standardized, and digitally enabled operating model.

ACCOUNTABILITIES

Lead TBS Japan Finance Solutions Operational Team covering Record-to-Report, Invoice-to-Cash, Acquire-to-Retire, Treasury, and in the future potentially also some activities related to direct & indirect Tax, ensuring delivery of high-quality, efficient and compliant finance operations.

Drive transformation and alignment to global process standards, ensuring Japan finance operations adopt and embed standardized global processes, methodologies and best practices as defined by TBS globally, reducing local customizations and enhancing consistency across the network.

Support the centralization of select finance activities to the Global Hub in Poland, partnering closely with the Poland Hub leadership to define the transition roadmap, manage knowledge transfer, and ensure seamless migration of in-scope processes while maintaining business continuity and service quality.

Champion digital transformation initiatives, including the SAP S/4HANA implementation in Japan, driving global process standardization and ensuring local readiness, stakeholder alignment, data migration integrity, and successful adoption of the new platform and related digital tools.

Operate as TBS Leader and business partner locally, acting as a single point of contact for the local Japan Finance Director, Global Tax, Global Treasury and other local leadership, ensuring strong alignment and collaboration between TBS services and local business needs.

Partner with different TBS towers (i.e. Global Inventory, Fixed Assets, Invoice-to-Cash and R2R Operations Hub, Controllership / Data Analytics & Insights team, Risk & Controls, TBS Strategic and Relationship Management team and other delivery center leads) as well as DD&T, global & local finance, legal and compliance teams to identify and drive continuous improvement, robotic and intelligent automation initiatives as well as identifying and implementing new technological tools, methodologies, and improved processes which enable better process standardization, improved user experience and efficiency gains.

Ensure all processes and services are compliant with Takeda policies, global standards and Japanese regulatory requirements (including IFRS and J-GAAP). Lead to enhance the risk and control framework for the operations and ensure practices are in line with company risk, J-GAAP/IFRS and US SOX and control best practices.

Ensure effective escalation model is in place locally and maintain strong governance and service delivery oversight.

Be a lead change agent for global and TBS initiatives, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within the Japan finance team and in line with the Global Finance Vision.

Upskilling of team including capability building aligned with future operating model.

CORE ELEMENTS RELATED TO THIS ROLE

Proven record of leading and running large accounting & controlling teams and delivering shared service strategies, ideally in a Japanese business environment

Finance transformation experience in a global organization, including ERP implementations (SAP S/4HANA experience desirable)

Demonstrated experience in centralizing or transitioning finance activities to shared service centers or global hubs

Proven track record of driving continuous improvement initiatives applying common methodologies such as LEAN or EOAR

Proven people management experience – successful record of recruiting, organizing, developing and retaining professional staff in a large team (~50 people)

Strong experience in finance & accounting, analysis, reporting, controlling and management at a multinational organization

Strategic change and project management experience

Strong customer service focus & business partnering skills

Strong stakeholder and relationship management, with the ability to navigate Japanese business culture and corporate etiquette

DIMENSIONS AND ASPECTS

Technical/Functional (Line) Expertise

Operational experience in leading shared services or country finance organizations, preferably in Japan

Senior Finance role with strategic, transformation and operational experience

Strong understanding of end-to-end Finance business processes

Experience with SAP ERP systems; SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration experience is a strong advantage

Understanding of Japanese regulatory and tax requirements, J-SOX compliance and local statutory reporting

Leadership

Strong strategic thinking and decision making

Demonstrated success in leading Finance teams through significant transformation, including process centralization and system migrations

Experience developing and managing high-performing teams (~50 people) in high-volume and high-pressure environments

Ability to form strong working relationships across a matrix environment with ability to collaborate and influence executive leadership

Excellent communication, listening and influencing skills; ability to listen, anticipate customer needs and influence solutions

Act as a change agent, drive TBS culture and mindset within Japan, championing global standardization and digital transformation

Decision-making and Autonomy

Technically strong with proven ability to make sound decisions and lead projects to successful completion

Ability to lead effectively and work concurrently across multiple priorities in a goal-oriented, timeline-driven, and remote management work environment

Solutions oriented, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and develop qualitative and quantitative approaches / methodologies for identifying and assessing various options to provide solutions

Strong business acumen with an ability to understand the business implications of decisions

Result oriented – drives to pragmatic solutions and balances the ideal with the practical in order to deliver best value to the organization

Makes timely decisions and translates strategy into action. Ensures impact is quantified, tracked and realized

Interaction

Establishes credibility and earns respect with Japan and global Finance stakeholders. Able to facilitate alignment without compromising principles

A partner to the Japan Finance Leads, Country Managers, TBS LT and other Takeda Corporate Functions

Engages with the business to understand current and anticipate future requirements

Partners with the Finance Solutions Team and the Global Hub in Poland to promote harmonization, simplification and transformation programs

Able to influence with and without authority

Innovation

Challenges the status quo to drive greater value and growth for the business

Drives simplification, innovation and continuous improvement activities while ensuring business continuity and minimal business disruptions

Ensures sharing of knowledge and best practices across Japan, the Global Hub in Poland, TBS sites and TBS globally

Applies digital environment knowledge — including SAP S/4HANA and automation tools — to create better solutions and insights

Complexity

Operating in a complex, R&D-centric, heavily regulated environment with specific Japanese regulatory requirements

Demonstrated capability to successfully collaborate in a matrix organization and manage a complex cross-functional environment driving the execution of Japan Finance transition and transformation plans

Drives changes in-country and within the delivery center, with the combination of process, project and change management expertise

Working within an international / global remit and across cultures, with particular sensitivity to Japanese business practices and cultural norms

EDUCATION, BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS

Desirable: Master's in Business Administration

Required: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or related field

Professional Finance leader with 10–15+ years' experience in industry

Professional Finance Qualification such as CPA (Japanese or international), ACA, ACCA or equivalent; Strong experience in finance & accounting, treasury, planning, analysis, budgeting, reporting, controlling and management at a multinational organization

Fluent in English and Japanese (both written and spoken)

Experience with SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration is highly desirable

High degree of integrity, confidence and self-awareness

Confident and persuasive with strong influencing skills; able to win internal support for new ideas and initiatives

Appreciates, understands and effectively negotiates within and across other cultures, with strong sensitivity to Japanese business customs

Customer-centric and solutions-oriented attitude with demonstrable experience in providing solutions based on customer needs

Interpersonal Skills: People leadership and management skills (e.g. energetic, visionary, motivational, resilient & highly driven individual who thrives on professional challenges)

Strong negotiation & interpersonal skills (e.g. tact/diplomacy, persuasion, cooperation, ability to motivate others)

Experienced in handling sensitive and confidential issues/situations and cultural sensitivities

TBS problem-solving and entrepreneurial mindset — driven to create and innovate

Finance process and technology knowledge. Familiar with Finance technology – e.g. SAP, SAP S/4HANA, BlackLine etc. and enabling technology

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Flexibility in working hours due to global nature (different time zones, including regular collaboration with European and Polish teams) and demands of the role and the organization

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

Flexibility to travel domestically and internationally
